text: Lasers work by focusing sound waves.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.note: 2012 survey; older data. 47% answered correctly (false). NSF reports the share answering correctly; don’t-know is counted on the wrong side.

truthSource.label: NASA, What is a laser?
truthSource.oneLine: A laser is amplified light, not sound.

lesson.tip: A technical-sounding explanation can still be wrong. “Laser” is short for light amplification; check what the name stands for.
